newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up six cents to 14.23 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up six cents to 14.23 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price edged up six cents to 14.23 ringgit ($5.68) a kg on firm demand from Japanese buyers despite absence of a fresh lead from the London Metal Exchange (LME) which was closed for a holiday on Monday.
"There was strong Japanese buying, coupled with some European and local demand, and this pushed the market up," said a trader.
Initial bids were 156 tonnes against offers of 108. Turnover fell to 125 tonnes from 147 on Monday. The premium over the LME widened to $100 a tonne from $65 previously.
